state: Research complete; combined verification and merge tracked in the pull request.
scope: Distinct source-boundary inspections, not repeated executions or claimed exhaustive proof. No external consumer corpus was downloaded or changed.
benchmarkLimitations: Synthetic corpora on a shared VM; component timings do not establish end-to-end consumer speedups. SQL traced transient allocation excludes retained caches and process RSS.

benchmarks.method: Alternating baseline/candidate wall time; exact diagnostic equality.
Same corpus; cold clears lexical, coordinate and index caches before each sample.
Nine interleaved rounds, eight iterations; baseline HEAD and candidate loaded together; current-thread CPU; identical diagnostics.
Nine interleaved rounds, eight iterations; baseline HEAD and candidate loaded together; current-thread CPU; identical diagnostics.
Alternating baseline/current with matching diagnostics; shared VM wall time.

passes.evidenceAndOutcome: **Lazy file facts (`_file_context.py`).** Reviewed parse failure handling, project AST reuse, freshness and fact lifetime. Existing equality guard `unit.source == self.source` prevents stale shared trees; syntax/Unicode failures abstain. Existing file-context tests exercise source changes, BOM decoding, collection and rule-order independence. Outcome: retain; no demonstrated gap.

**AST index (`_ast_index.py`).** Reviewed breadth-first query order, `isinstance` semantics, parent mapping and shared singleton operator/context nodes. Query buckets preserve AST traversal order; parent cache deliberately preserves last-parent semantics. Existing file-context and AST-index regressions cover both. Outcome: retain; optimizing parent construction without that contract would be risky.

**Source decoding and Unicode gates (`_source.py`).** Reviewed encoding discovery and normalized symbol prefilters. `tokenize.open` honors encoding cookies/BOM; NFKC is applied only to the necessary symbol gate, while AST/source locations use original text. Existing source-decoding/native-prefilter tests validate boundaries. Outcome: retain.

**Import resolution (`_imports.py`).** Reviewed ambiguous imports, dotted aliases, non-import shadowing, module-only TYPE_CHECKING imports and comprehension result bindings. Conservative ambiguity/rebinding exclusions are intentional; no name-only inference added. Existing import-capture/type-guard tests and package tests validate. Outcome: retain.

**Regex walrus suffix analysis (`prefer_walrus_regex_match.py`, SARJ081).** Evidence: each candidate scanned every later statement with a fresh NodeVisitor; 200 compact regex-result pairs took 2094.627 ms warm in initial baseline. Replaced repeated suffix walks with one last-containing-statement index per candidate body, retaining every Name context and nested/deferred use exclusion. Existing later-use, rebinding, compiled-pattern, suite and native-spelling tests exercise semantics. Outcome: measured performance fix; paired benchmark details below.

**Stream-loop lexical gate (`prefer_walrus_stream_loop.py`, SARJ077).** Evidence: a valid `while (\n True\n):` loop with the exact supported producer/guard/body returned zero findings because the regex required a physical single-line header. Existing AST matcher already handles the header correctly. Smallest fix: necessary substring gates followed by unchanged AST proof. Added multiline-parenthesis and explicit-continuation positives plus multiline False negative. Outcome: extend existing semantic rule to equivalent syntax; no rewrite/fix-policy change.

**Async cache correctness (`no_async_function_cache.py`, SARJ507).** Reviewed innermost decorator proof, active lru_cache sizing, relative/nested import shadowing and generator yield ownership. Existing cache rule excludes disabled/dynamic sizes and transformed async functions. Targeted baseline: cache + context tests passed 71 non-fixture cases; package suite validates all cache boundaries. Outcome: retain.

**Loop string growth (`no_string_concat_in_loop.py`).** Reviewed lexical scope boundaries, backedge resets, loop-local values and single-iteration exclusions using existing nested-function/class/while-probe/f-string tests. Current exclusions distinguish accumulators from per-iteration values and observed intermediate strings. Outcome: retain; no unsafe blanket concatenation expansion.

**Set overlap (`prefer_set_isdisjoint.py`, SARJ431).** Reviewed receiver provenance, known iterables, shadowed builtins, dict key views, boolean-only use and branch invalidation. Existing scanner excludes stored intersections and deferred captured bindings; suggestion remains non-autofixing because equality/hash effects can differ. Existing rule and project-integration tests validate. Outcome: retain.

**Collection comprehensions (`prefer_collection_comprehension.py`).** Reviewed target observability, computed filter projections, leaked bindings, reflection and comprehension scopes. Existing owner binding/namespace observer analysis protects behavior; constructor projections and filtered loops already share helpers. Existing rule tests cover captured/observed targets and expression boundaries. Outcome: retain.

**Builtin proof duplication (`prefer_native_string_check.py`).** Evidence: `_plain_string_adapter` repeated the exact direct/imported builtin proof already owned by `_builtin_type`. Reused that helper for `str`; preserved lexical/import mutation checks. Existing native-string tests (including builtin shadowing/mutation and intentional ValidationError contracts) passed in focused run. Outcome: DRY fix; no rule expansion.

**Anchored regex validation (`prefer_regex_fullmatch.py`).** Reviewed flag exclusion, compiled pattern ownership, escaping, character classes and top-level alternation. Rule already rejects invalid/recursive/overflowing regex compilation and intentional newline contracts remain suppressible. Focused regex-fullmatch tests passed. Outcome: retain; do not guess ambiguous regex policies.

**Elapsed clock scope (`prefer_monotonic_for_elapsed_time.py`, SARJ461).** Reviewed every-read proof, nested scope/comprehension escapes, clock mutation and severity of literal duration loops. Existing code separates advisory telemetry from proven while-loop duration comparisons. Package tests exercise those boundaries. Outcome: retain.

**Fixed sleep arithmetic (`no_fixed_sleep_in_loop.py`, SARJ485).** Evidence: a valid AST with a 401-digit integer divided by 1 raised OverflowError during constant folding, crashing analysis. Owner is `_folded_seconds`; no-change harm is failure of the whole lint operation. Catch overflow at the arithmetic boundary and abstain, preserving literal-positive detection. Added division, floor-division and mixed float addition/multiplication overflow regressions, each first compiled as valid Python. Outcome: robustness fix; no new diagnostic on runtime-invalid expressions.

**Async cancellation ownership (`no_swallowed_asyncio_cancellation.py`, SARJ458).** Reviewed straight-line exits, compound finalizers, child-task cleanup and canonical sleep severity proof. Current ownership/provenance boundaries are conservative and documented; compound handlers/uncancel abstentions are intentional. Package tests validate aliases and cancellation interactions. Outcome: retain.

**Subprocess lifecycle (`subprocess_kill_without_reap.py`, SARJ464).** Reviewed unique owned Popen binding, direct timeout wait, terminal kill, later reapers and global SIGCHLD/os ownership. Existing proof rejects escaped/borrowed/context-owned handles and recognizes wait/communicate/poll. Package rule tests validate boundary. Outcome: retain; no interprocedural guessing.

**Async exit cleanup (`async_cleanup_registered_synchronously.py`).** Reviewed ExitStack/AsyncExitStack constructor provenance, unescaped receiver and async callback resolution. Rule requires proven local ownership and recognizes async functions rather than names. Focused async cleanup tests passed. Outcome: retain.

**Credentialed CORS (`no_cors_wildcard_with_credentials.py`, SARJ028).** Reviewed literal keyword dictionaries, nested effective unpacking, dynamic override invalidation and exact universal regexes. Existing scanner rejects computed credential flags and unknown effective keyword state. Package CORS tests validate exact duplicates/unpacks. Outcome: retain; expanding regex-language equivalence would require a stronger proof.

**Interpreter source argv (`no_interpreter_source_arguments.py`).** Reviewed subprocess/asyncio/exec/spawn argument projection, executable override, shell exclusion and stdin text/encoding compatibility. Existing shared interpreter classifier owns flag semantics and the rule handles literal source channels. Package interpreter argv/encoding tests validate. Outcome: retain.

**Secret log fields (`no_secret_in_log.py`).** Reviewed f-string/message interpolation, structured logger binding, literal kwargs mappings and effective dictionary overrides. Redaction token exclusions and opaque dynamic mappings avoid guessing. Existing secret-name/logging tests exercise semantic references. Outcome: retain; no name-list inflation.

**Embedded SQL extraction (`_sql.py`).** Reviewed recursive static concatenation/interpolation API and newline-preserving SQL-noise masking. Shared `sql_string_value` already accepts a configurable interpolation placeholder; callers should use that rather than reimplement it. Existing SQL helper tests validate parsing/noise. Outcome: retain helper; apply reuse at pass 24.

**SELECT-star docstrings (`no_select_star.py`, SARJ021).** Evidence: rule maintained a second complete docstring-owner scan equivalent to `context.docstring_node_ids`. Switched to the shared cached fact and removed redundant helper/index import. Existing SQL SELECT tests and shared docstring-fact tests cover module/class/function strings and traversal. Outcome: DRY fix; diagnostic semantics unchanged.

**Store duplicate policy (`store_insert_requires_on_conflict.py`, SARJ018).** Reviewed executable-SQL context, replay-named owning callable, conflict clauses, same-target NOT EXISTS and intervening binding updates. Existing warning leaves dynamic policies opaque and requires actual SQL use. Package store-write tests validate. Outcome: retain; broad source-name-only policy not expanded.

**Concatenated offset pagination (`no_offset_pagination.py`, SARJ025).** Evidence: HEAD baseline returned 0 for `'SELECT ... ' + f'LIMIT 10 OFFSET {offset}'`, current helper returned 1. Previous custom renderer preserved markers only for a top-level JoinedStr and lost nested f-string interpolation through concatenation. Reused `sql_string_value(..., interpolation_placeholder=':__sarj_dynamic__')`, deleting duplicate renderer. Added both concatenation orders, nested concatenation, static-offset/dynamic-limit negative, quoted SQL text negative, exact diagnostic count/location, and executable public positive/negative scenario. Outcome: extend existing rule to the same demonstrated dynamic SQL semantics. No severity/autofix change.

**Mutable Pydantic factories (`shared_mutable_pydantic_factory.py`).** Reviewed captured mutable aliases, cyclic alias resolution, model customization and fresh factory values. Evidence: check_context rebuilt ImportIndex from the exact same context tree despite context.imports owning that fact. Reused context.imports and moved type-only ImportIndex import. Existing shared-factory tests cover alias/mutation/inert-vs-custom severity. Outcome: DRY shared-analysis fix, unchanged findings.

**Pydantic validator outputs (`no_invalid_pydantic_validator_return.py`, SARJ515).** Reviewed return literals vs stored scalar/None/Union/Literal domains, numeric assignability, annotation budgets, multiple-validator abstention and unknown-field precedence. Existing proof is deliberately narrow and contains proper invalid-state boundaries. Package validator-return and precedence tests validate. Outcome: retain.

**Pydantic empty bounds (`no_impossible_pydantic_field_bounds.py`).** Reviewed exclusive/inclusive integer endpoints, multiple_of arithmetic, adjacent floating values, finiteness and exact float conversion. Existing code already catches huge-int float conversion overflow and avoids approximating integers. Package bounds tests validate. Outcome: retain.

**Unknown validator fields (`no_unknown_pydantic_validator_field.py`).** Reviewed canonical decorator stacks, explicitly deferred check_fields, wildcard targets and complete declared field set. Existing owner abstains on unknown/composed methods, preserving subclass extension contracts. Package validator-field tests validate. Outcome: retain.

**Discriminated unions (`prefer_discriminated_model_union.py`).** Reviewed composition of data-union diagnostics with nullable model-validator proof, test exclusion, stability checks and suppression ownership. Reuses the dedicated discriminator analyzer, emits advisory model-union findings without changing external accepted combinations. Existing round-two/scope/runtime regressions validate. Outcome: retain.

**Suppression comment cache (`_suppression_comments.py`, `rule_base.is_suppressed`).** Reviewed actual comment tokenization vs string content, invalid marker grammar, immutable maps and bounded cache. maxsize=1 prevents retaining a project of sources; comment map is read-only. Existing noqa/suppression tests cover strings, malformed markers and exact codes. Outcome: retain.

SQL static concatenation composition (_sql.ts/sqlTextOf): erased operand wrappers caused `("SEL" as string) + ("ECT * FROM users" satisfies string)` to dispatch two fragments, missing SELECT *. Minimal reproduction failed before implementation. Fix: unwrap at the existing extraction boundary. Validation: _sql suite and three downstream SQL suites.

SQL native join ownership (_sql.ts/joinedFragmentCall): wrapped arrays, wrapped callees and static computed `join` members lost whole-statement proof. A reproduction emitted fragments plus separator instead of one query. Fix: use outerExpression and ASTUtils.getPropertyName, consuming only recognized static member text. Unknown methods remain opaque. Validation: wrapped joins, unknown member negative, nested executed query interaction.

SQL join coercion exclusion (_sql.ts/fragmentArrayText): nested arrays must remain outside the deliberately bounded string-fragment contract even through assertions. Fix: check the unwrapped element before recursing. Validation: direct and wrapped nested-array negatives.

SQL discarded-expression boundary (_sql.ts/isDiscardedSqlText): comparing unwrap(parent) to current fails for more than one erased wrapper. Fix: climb to outerExpression at each concatenation level. Executed queries inside substitutions remain visited. Validation: nested assertion+satisfies void negative and existing executed-call positives.

SQL lexer reuse cost (_sql.ts, no-dynamic-sql.ts): interpolation analysis ran sqlSingleQuotedRanges and stripSqlNoise, each allocating/masking the whole text. Fix: expose one bounded sqlNoiseInfo scan yielding both products; existing public helper contracts preserved. Validation: lexer suite, dynamic SQL suite, before/after wall-time benchmark.

Dynamic SQL operand collection (no-dynamic-sql.ts/concatOperands): recursive array spreads copy the accumulated left prefix for every + in a left-deep concat. Fix: explicit LIFO traversal pushes right then left into one output array. Validation: existing multi-offender/order cases, wrapped concatenation regressions, before/after 80,499-byte corpus benchmark.

Dynamic SQL wrapped static context (no-dynamic-sql.ts/staticStatementText): nested assertions obscured SELECT and quote boundaries, causing two reproductions to miss runtime fragments/quoted values. Fix: unwrap before text reconstruction and flattening; use shared staticString for static operand admission. Validation: two failing positives and static/comment negatives added before fixes.

SQL lexer dialect/noise boundary (_sql.ts/scanSqlNoise): inspected doubled quotes, nested comments, dollar tags, numbered parameters and UTF-16 offsets. Existing masking preserves offsets and excludes comments/identifiers; dialect escape modes remain documented exclusions. Outcome: retain implementation. Validation: existing _sql lexer regressions.

Dynamic SQL static-fragment policy (no-dynamic-sql.ts/isStaticFragment): uppercase names remain an explicitly documented legacy exemption; names cannot prove static values. Broadening detection would violate current policy without a separate adoption decision. Outcome: no rule expansion. Validation: existing uppercase/static/member/comment/tagged-template tests.

SQL star projection ownership (no-select-star.ts/hasRealSelectStar): inspected function star arguments, multiplication, qualified projections and EXISTS exclusions. Existing bounded lexical model has nested-SELECT context limits; replacing it requires a parser-backed scope model, so no speculative expansion. Outcome: retain current contract. Validation: no-select-star suite including query reconstruction interaction.

SQL OFFSET admission (no-offset-pagination.ts): inspected query-shape requirement and recognized placeholder styles to avoid standalone/prose matches. Keyset pagination is a review advisory; random access can justify OFFSET. Outcome: preserve warning-first rule. Validation: no-offset-pagination suite.

Insert conflict advisory scope (store-insert-requires-on-conflict.ts): nearest callable selection excludes top-level/anonymous cases, known conflict syntax is not idempotence proof. Name heuristics are documented and cannot support an error promotion. Outcome: no expansion. Validation: insert rule suite and SQL helper regressions.

Static-string alias cache (_static-string.ts/scopedStaticString): checked stable aliases, lexical shadowing, later writes, cycles and per-SourceCode WeakMap lifetime. Cache keys are scope variables, not names/filenames; no cross-file reuse defect. Outcome: retain. Validation: existing _static-string cases, including changed text at one filename.

AST traversal boundary (_for-each-ast-child.ts/_for-each-own-ast-child.ts): checked array holes, metadata fields, parent cycles and visitor short-circuit. Parser visitor keys are preferred where available; own reflection is explicitly bounded and skips parent. Outcome: no extra general-purpose traversal cache. Validation: package typecheck and existing consumers.

Native fetch alias provenance (_native-fetch-reference.ts): checked local global receiver shadowing, reassignment, cyclic/transitive aliases, destructuring defaults and eight-binding limit. Existing scope-variable proof abstains from unknown clients. Outcome: retain. Validation: fetch timeout and detached fetch suites.

Fetch init override ordering (require-fetch-timeout.ts plus tests): inspected later spreads, duplicate signal properties, unknown computed keys, null versus undefined, accessors and prototype signals. Existing handling models effective value uncertainty and Request inheritance; broadening would create false positives. Outcome: retain. Validation: require-fetch-timeout suite including native Request behavior tests.

Raw fetch exemptions (no-raw-fetch-outside-clients.ts): inspected native fetch reference reuse, allowed wrapper modules, presigned transfer handoff, effect/server-action ownership. These policy exclusions deliberately differ from cancellation correctness. Outcome: retain separate callers over shared provenance helper. Validation: raw fetch suite.

JSON primitive-array type delegation (no-json-stringify-object-equality.ts/syntaxMayContainObject): `[value]` with value:number was reported before consulting the checker. Fix: tri-state syntax classification returns unknown for unknown elements, allowing the existing typed owner to decide. Minimal negative failed before implementation. Validation: typed primitive expression and existing typed object/unknown positives.

JSON primitive expression normalization (same rule): assertions, unary numbers, template strings and nested primitive arrays were treated as objects. Fix: recursively classify arrays and unwrap elements; primitive-valued syntax returns false. Three minimal negatives failed before implementation. Validation: wrappers, signed number, interpolated string, nested arrays, existing primitive exclusions.

JSON RegExp literal object boundary (same rule): ESTree Literal also includes RegExp objects; two distinct regexes both serialize to `{}` but escaped detection. Fix: distinguish regex literals in syntax classification. Minimal positive failed before implementation. Validation: regex-array and nested-object positives, primitive negatives.

JSON serializer alias provenance (same rule/isJsonStringify): checked const destructured aliases, defaults, imported/shadowed serializers and later writes. Existing native-global and identity checks remain conservative. Outcome: preserve alias boundary and no autofix. Validation: complete JSON equality suite.

CORS effective-property semantics (no-cors-wildcard-with-credentials.ts): inspected case-sensitive JS property replacement followed by case-insensitive native header combination, spreads, accessors, prototypes and straight-line receiver writes. Existing handling abstains once proof is lost. Outcome: no broad duplicate CORS rule. Validation: CORS rule suite.

Exported Next config alias safety (_exported-next-config-property.ts): checked const aliases, repeated effective keys, unknown spreads/computed keys, scope identity, escapes and isolated CommonJS export. Conservative reference rejection prevents false claims about mutated exported objects. Outcome: retain. Validation: Next source-map/SVG suites.

SVG CSP hardening (no-dangerously-allow-svg.ts): inspected script-src none, sandbox presence/flags, duplicate directives and attachment disposition. Existing conservative duplicate-policy rejection is intentional; no inferred policy from dynamic values. Outcome: preserve security boundary. Validation: SVG suite.

Next matcher static syntax (require-static-next-matcher.ts): inspected direct exported config, nested arrays/objects, computed fields, spreads and erased wrappers. Schema validity remains Next's owner; this rule must not duplicate the full framework validator. Outcome: retain. Validation: static matcher suite.

Random ID reporting admission (no-insecure-random-id.ts): strong security-name detection is the only reporting branch; all later nonsecurity/path tests return into a no-report tail. Fix: remove ineffectual classification and traversal, preserving names/provenance/report behavior. Validation: full random-ID suite and before/after nonsecurity corpus benchmark; no duplicate implementation-shaped tests added.

UUID native suggestion safety (prefer-native-random-uuid.ts): inspected native global availability, comment-preserving suggestions, resolved imports and locally shadowed require. No runtime-native dependency assumption changed; nonzero-argument/custom UUID modes remain excluded. Outcome: retain. Validation: UUID suite.

Collection-copy performance advisory (no-reduce-accumulator-copy.ts): checked native Array/ReadonlyArray signature proof, inline fresh seed requirement, accumulator writes, nested functions/loops and copy methods. Existing type-aware ownership and no-autofix boundary protects snapshots. Outcome: retain. Validation: reducer suite.

String accumulation repetition (no-string-concat-in-loop.ts): inspected local binding lookup, declarations inside loops, direct forEach callbacks, small static loops and immediate exits. A one-shot append is not repeated growth; warning language already avoids claiming a measured allocation cost. Outcome: retain. Validation: string-concat suite.

Shared hygiene boundary (logging/secrets/path/comment helpers): inspected reusable logger matchers/options, credential words versus metadata flags, generated-header provenance, fixtures, protected technical comment signals and safe deletion ranges. Shared owners already prevent divergent vocabulary; no name-only semantic expansion or blanket suppression added. Outcome: retain. Validation: logging, secret-names, paths, comments and prose-budget suites; package lint/types/tests.
